| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="huge_val"></a>`HUGE_VAL` | `(__builtin_huge_val())` | Overflow result for double. |
| <a id="huge_valf"></a>`HUGE_VALF` | `(__builtin_huge_valf())` | Overflow result for float. |
| <a id="huge_vall"></a>`HUGE_VALL` | `(__builtin_huge_vall())` | Overflow result for long double. |
| <a id="infinity"></a>`INFINITY` | `(__builtin_inff())` | Positive infinity, as a float. |
| <a id="nan"></a>`NAN` | `(__builtin_nanf(""))` | A quiet NaN, as a float. |
| <a id="isnan"></a>`isnan(x)` |  | Non-zero if `x` is a NaN. |
| <a id="isinf"></a>`isinf(x)` |  | 1 for +infinity, -1 for -infinity, 0 otherwise. |
| <a id="isfinite"></a>`isfinite(x)` |  | Non-zero if `x` is neither infinite nor a NaN. |
| <a id="signbit"></a>`signbit(x)` |  | Non-zero if `x` has its sign bit set. |
